ruleDefinitions.name: Third Party Software DLL Sideloading
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects DLL sideloading of DLLs that are part of third party software (zoom, discord....etc) Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: (ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\commfunc\\\.dll$") AND  NOT ((ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\local\\\\Google\\\\Chrome\\\\Application\\\\.*") OR (ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Lenovo\\\\Communications\\ Utility\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Lenovo\\\\Communications\\ Utility\\\\"))))) OR (ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\tosbtkbd\\\.dll$") AND  NOT ((ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Toshiba\\\\Bluetooth\\ Toshiba\\ Stack\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Toshiba\\\\Bluetooth\\ Toshiba\\ Stack\\\\"))))
